title: Oozy Springy Moroccan Burrata Mrouzia
description: A springy and energizing Moroccan dish featuring burrata and a rich deglaze fond, all cooked in a raclette grill.

ingredients.name: Mozzarella Burrata
ingredients.notes: High-quality burrata cheese with a creamy center

ingredients.name: Ras el hanout
ingredients.notes: A Moroccan spice mix of cinnamon, ginger, and other spices

ingredients.name: Extra-virgin olive oil
ingredients.notes: For cooking and finishing the dish

ingredients.name: Capers
ingredients.notes: Sliced capers for added texture and flavor

instructions: Preheat the raclette grill to medium-high heat.
In a small saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the ras el hanout and cook for an additional minute.
Place the burrata cheese on the raclette grill and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until it starts to melt and ooze.
Remove the burrata from the grill and place it on a plate.
Pour the garlic-ras el hanout fond over the burrata cheese.
Sprinkle chopped pistachios and fresh mint over the top.
Drizzle with lemon juice and serve immediately.
